heroHeadline:
Find what's ==holding growth back==.
Build what comes next.
heroSubheadline: EchelonFox works with established companies to identify the commercial constraint that matters most, then connects positioning, customer acquisition, sales processes, and technology into a clearer way to grow.

name: Commercial diagnosis and positioning
shortDescription: Understand how the business makes money, find the constraint that matters most, and make sure the company describes itself in a way its best customers recognise.

name: Customer acquisition and conversion
shortDescription: Get in front of the right buyers and turn their interest into enquiries and sales, through the channels the diagnosis shows are worth the money.

name: Sales process, CRM, and follow-up
shortDescription: Make sure the interest you've already paid for gets followed up, and that the customers you already have come back.

name: Practical AI and automation
shortDescription: Use AI and automation where it removes a real bottleneck — lead response, scheduling, follow-up, and admin — built inside the tools you already use, with a person to hand over to.

title: Beauty supply retailer, Maryland
result: Campaigns, promotions, and Sunday staffing set around when sales actually happen.
description: They asked for ads. The constraint was knowing their customers and their calendar.

title: Independent insurance agency
result: Live, with quote requests arriving through the site outside office hours instead of only by phone during them.
description: They needed a new website. The gap was how a prospect asks for a quote.

title: Premium pet care company
result: Live, with service and booking information structured for local search and enquiries collected in one place rather than across social inboxes.
description: They needed a website. The leak was enquiries scattered across social inboxes.
